Patient: [redacted name]

Date of Birth: [redacted date]
Specimen Type: Peripheral blood
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Rule out Down syndrome

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis

PREVIOUS TESTING
Rapid aneuploidy PCR performed (see separate report)

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

INTERPRETATION
Normal female karyotype. No evidence of trisomy 21 or other chromosomal abnormalities detected. This result confirms the previous rapid PCR findings.

METHOD
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured, harvested, and G-banded according to standard protocols. Twenty metaphases were analyzed at a resolution of 450-550 bands.

LIMITATIONS
This test detects numerical and structural chromosomal abnormalities at the resolution stated. Subtle rearrangements, low-level mosaicism (<10%), and single gene mutations are not detected by this method.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], MD, PhD
